# Vinay Kumar's Portfolio

> Machine Learning Engineer exploring deep learning, NLP, and systems engineering. Notes, tutorials, and deep dives into AI research.

## Sections

- [Transformers](/transformers/): Transformer architectures, DETR, attention mechanisms
- [NLP](/nlp/): Naïve Bayes classifiers, Regular Expressions, NLP book notes, Stanford CS224N
- [Speech](/speech/): Speech processing lectures, signal-to-symbol transformation
- [Blogs](/blogs/): Deep learning, physics, probability, system design notes
- [Python](/python/): Design patterns (Strategy pattern, ABC)
- [Algorithms](/algorithms/): Sorting algorithms, hash tables, linked list Q&A
- [Gists](/gists/): Python snippets (MappingProxyType, walrus operator, __slots__)
- [ML System Design](/mlsd/): When and when not to use ML
- [TIL](/til/): Today I Learned  -  numpy vs pandas access control

## Key Articles

- [Sorting Algorithms](/algorithms/sorting/): Insertion sort, binary insertion sort, merge sort, heap sort with complexity analysis
- [Hash Tables](/algorithms/hashtables/): Hashing, collision resolution (chaining, open addressing), hash functions
- [Linked List Q&A](/algorithms/QA/): Interview questions on linked lists
- [DL Interviews](/blogs/deep_learning/dl_interviews/): Maximum entropy, data augmentation, overfitting, odds of success
- [Probability Theory](/blogs/prob/intro/): Bayesian foundations, red/blue box experiment, random variables
- [Naïve Bayes](/nlp/naive_bayes/): Multinomial Naïve Bayes for text classification
- [Regular Expressions](/nlp/regex/): RegEx fundamentals for text processing
- [Einops Part 1](/blogs/deep_learning/einops/): Tensor rearranging with einops
- [Einops Part 2](/blogs/deep_learning/einops2/): ConvNets and Multi-Head Attention with einops
- [Loss Functions](/blogs/deep_learning/loss/): Cross entropy implementation
- [TensorFlow Tutorial](/blogs/deep_learning/blog_tf_v1/): TF v1.0 basics, sessions, placeholders, neural networks
- [Distribution Shift](/blogs/deep_learning/dl_04_09/): Covariate, label, and concept shift correction
- [EM Spectrum](/blogs/physics/blog_01282021/): Electromagnetic spectrum interactions with matter
- [CDN](/blogs/system_design/cdn/): Content Delivery Networks explained (in Hindi)
- [Design Patterns](/python/design_patterns/): Strategy pattern in Python
- [ML System Design Overview](/mlsd/01_overview/): When to use and not use ML
- [numpy vs pandas](/til/042123/): Row-major vs column-major access control
- [CS224N Lecture 1](/nlp/cs224n/cs224n_1/): Word meaning, distributional semantics
